security_audit.summary: Most static shell-execution, obfuscation, path-traversal, and documentation URL findings are false positives caused by JavaScript template literals, ANSI color codes, static imports, or examples. Real risk remains from outbound requests to www.guaikei.com, sensitive token handling, local result persistence, query-string credentials, and a hardcoded default token.

remediation.suggestion: Remove the bundled fallback token and fail closed when GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN is missing or invalid.
Send credentials in an Authorization header or signed request body instead of query parameters.
Document requests to www.guaikei.com and require explicit user consent before external network access.
Make result-file writing optional and provide a clear retention or deletion setting.
Keep lock and output files in a dedicated cache directory and avoid deleting files outside that directory.

semantic_findings.title: Hardcoded Default API Token
semantic_findings.description: When GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN is missing or invalid, lib/key.js returns a fixed default token. A bundled shared token can hide network use, mix user traffic, and create quota or accountability risk.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code explicitly warns about a missing token and returns a fixed 32-character token value on line 20. This is direct evidence of a shared fallback credential.

semantic_findings.title: API Token Sent In URL Query Parameters
semantic_findings.description: The API token is placed in request query parameters for task creation and result polling. Query-string credentials are commonly captured in logs, proxies, and error reports.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both request builders include token in params and append querystring.stringify(params) to the path. The credential is therefore carried in the URL path for outbound requests.

semantic_findings.title: Public Social Content Collection With Local Persistence
semantic_findings.description: The skill extracts public Douyin links and media URLs, recommends retaining temporary CDN links, and writes full search results locally. This creates compliance and retention risk for collected social-media data.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documentation describes link extraction and retention of CDN links, while the script writes final results to last-search.json. The finding is about collection and retention intent, not a single API call.

content.user_title: Search Douyin Public Content by Keyword
content.value_statement: Teams need fast visibility into public Douyin trends. This skill searches keywords and returns structured video, image, author, and engagement data.
actual_capabilities: Searches public Douyin video and image posts by keyword.
Supports relevance, most-liked, and newest sorting modes.
Filters results by all time, one day, seven days, or half a year.
Limits returned results from 1 to 60 items.
Outputs results as structured JSON or readable Markdown.
Saves the latest successful search to scripts/last-search.json.
limitations: Requires Node.js and a GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN, with a limited default token fallback.
Only returns public data provided by the upstream API.
Depends on network access to a third-party API service.
Stores the latest search result locally unless the file is removed.

use_cases.title: Track Campaign Topics
use_cases.description: Search campaign keywords and review public posts, authors, links, and engagement counts.

use_cases.title: Find Short Video Ideas
use_cases.description: Identify common titles, formats, and themes from recent public Douyin results.

use_cases.title: Monitor Public Trends
use_cases.description: Compare recent keyword results by time filter and sorting mode to spot active topics.

prompt_templates.prompt: Search Douyin for AI tutorial and return 10 comprehensive results in JSON.

prompt_templates.prompt: Find public Douyin posts about new energy vehicles from the last seven days. Sort by newest and summarize the top results.

prompt_templates.title: Engagement Comparison
prompt_templates.scenario: Use sorting and a larger result count.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search summer travel with 20 results sorted by most liked. Compare themes, authors, and engagement signals.

prompt_templates.title: Competitor Pattern Scan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced research across several related keywords.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a half-year search for three competitor keywords. Return separate Markdown summaries and identify recurring creative patterns.

output_examples.output: The skill returns a success message with result count, publish time, author names, links, and engagement metrics.

output_examples.input: Search summer travel and request Markdown output.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a readable list of public posts with titles, authors, publish times, links, covers, and totals.

output_examples.input: Search a keyword that has no matching public content.
output_examples.output: The skill returns an empty result message with the sanitized keyword and selected filters.

best_practices: Use specific keywords that match the topic, brand, or product name.
Use a private API token for stable limits and predictable access.
Review platform rules before storing or reusing links and media URLs.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill to search for private or sensitive personal data.
Do not run high-frequency searches that may violate API limits.
Do not treat temporary CDN links as permanent source records.

faq.question: What data does this skill return?
faq.answer: It returns public Douyin post metadata, author names, links, publish times, and engagement counts from the upstream API.

faq.question: Does it access private Douyin content?
faq.answer: No. It is designed for public content available through the configured API service.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is an API token required?
faq.answer: Yes. The code reads GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN and falls back to a limited default token when it is missing.

faq.question: Can results be saved locally?
faq.answer: Yes. The script writes the latest search result to scripts/last-search.json.

faq.question: What output formats are available?
faq.answer: The skill supports structured JSON for automation and Markdown for human review.
